name: Gritty realism rests
author: Alexandria
summary: A short rest is 8 hours and a long rest is 7 days, for slower, grittier campaigns.

rules.text: A **short rest takes 8 hours** (a night's sleep) and a **long rest takes 7 days** of rest somewhere safe. Spells and features keep their usual recovery; only the time changes.

assistant.dm: Gritty realism is on: a short rest is 8 hours and a long rest is 7 days somewhere safe. When advancing the clock for a rest, use 8 hours or 7 days, not the usual 1 or 8 hours.
assistant.player: Gritty realism is on at this table: a short rest is 8 hours and a long rest is 7 days somewhere safe, so plan spells and hit dice around fewer rests.
